channels.source: Yahoo quote history and the deployed ChartChamp portfolio
channels.contentContract: Portfolio value, total and day return, top contributor and detractor, quote timestamp, and https://chartchamp.web.app/.

channels.source: Yahoo Finance trending tickers plus independent catalyst verification
channels.contentContract: No more than four tickers, each with a concise and verified reason it is trending; distinguish observed facts from inference.

channels.source: TrendSpider Sidekick with source verification where practical
channels.contentContract: Use concise category headers and bullet points that explain the material news, macro data, policy, rates, FX, geopolitical, earnings, or cross-asset drivers affecting markets and why each matters; omit filler and avoid predictions.

channels.source: Actual saved or subscribed TrendSpider scanner results, followed by Sidekick analysis
channels.contentContract: No more than five bullish standouts from scanners that were actually run; explain setup evidence and risk without buy or sell instructions.

channels.source: TrendSpider Sidekick plus official statistical or central-bank releases
channels.contentContract: Material releases only, with actual versus forecast and prior when available, why the result matters, and an official-source verification.
Up to three significant bullish and three bearish observations; label that opening versus closing and hedge intent is uncertain.

channels.source: TrendSpider Sidekick plus SEC Form 4 filings
channels.contentContract: Prior seven days, no more than five notable items, prioritizing verified open-market and cluster activity; explain that insider activity alone is not predictive.
